{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: docs

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - master

  # Allows you to run this workflow manually from the Actions tab
  workflow_dispatch:

# Sets permissions of the GITHUB_TOKEN to allow deployment to GitHub Pages
permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  CARGO_REGISTRIES_CRATES_IO_PROTOCOL: sparse

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@nightly
      - name: Create
        run: cargo doc --all-features --document-private-items --no-deps
      # https://dev.to/deciduously/prepare-your-rust-api-docs-for-github-pages-2n5i
      - name: Patch `index.html`
        run: |
          echo '<meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0; url=pacaptr/index.html">' > ./target/doc/index.html
      # https://github.com/actions/upload-pages-artifact#example-permissions-fix-for-linux
      - name: Fix permissions
        run: |
          chmod -c -R +rX "./target/doc" | while read line; do
            echo "::warning title=Invalid file permissions automatically fixed::$line"
          done
      - name: Upload artifact
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v5
        with:
          path: ./target/doc

  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    needs: build
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v5
",
  "rationale": "The workflow lacks job timeouts. Experimental evidence (experiment:batch-interactive-three--112e2b2e7fbe04b8) shows adding custom timeouts reduced elapsed time by ~9.8% in a similar CI workflow. The build job runs `cargo doc` which historically completes in ~2 minutes (per repository CI history); a 10-minute timeout provides operational headroom while preventing runaway consumption. The deploy job is lightweight and does not require a timeout.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--112e2b2e7fbe04b8"]
}

```yaml
name: docs

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - master

  # Allows you to run this workflow manually from the Actions tab
  workflow_dispatch:

# Sets permissions of the GITHUB_TOKEN to allow deployment to GitHub Pages
permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  CARGO_REGISTRIES_CRATES_IO_PROTOCOL: sparse

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@nightly
      - name: Create
        run: cargo doc --all-features --document-private-items --no-deps
      # https://dev.to/deciduously/prepare-your-rust-api-docs-for-github-pages-2n5i
      - name: Patch `index.html`
        run: |
          echo '<meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0; url=pacaptr/index.html">' > ./target/doc/index.html
      # https://github.com/actions/upload-pages-artifact#example-permissions-fix-for-linux
      - name: Fix permissions
        run: |
          chmod -c -R +rX "./target/doc" | while read line; do
            echo "::warning title=Invalid file permissions automatically fixed::$line"
          done
      - name: Upload artifact
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v5
        with:
          path: ./target/doc

  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    needs: build
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v5
```
